yf11166d6f62.add: - **Art. 354 in practice:** the President can **reduce or cancel** (never increase) the transfer of finances – tax shares and grants – from the Centre to the States; a National Emergency may cover **all of India or any part** (42nd Amendment).

y0ca34160cce.add: - **Art. 353:** during a National Emergency the Centre can give **executive directions to a State on any matter**; FRs other than Arts 20-21 are suspended only by a **Presidential order under Art. 359** (Art. 19 automatically under Art. 358 only in war/external aggression) – so **not all FRs** are suspended.

y3a9aab8a951.add: - **Grounds used:** **1962** (Chinese aggression, Oct; in force till Jan 1968) and **1971** (Pakistan, Dec) – **external aggression**; **1975** – **internal disturbance** (made while the 1971 one was in force).

y7a573b7b9e1.add: - **Single citizenship** (Art. 9; from the UK) despite a dual polity; **USA** (national + State) and **Switzerland** (federal, canton and commune) have more than one level of citizenship.

y4264f2fac6e.add: - **'One Nation One Tax'** (GST, 2017) is a uniform, centralising arrangement – **not** a feature of a true federation; independent judiciary and bicameralism are.

y76eafe86326.add: - **Bicameral State legislatures:** only **six** States (AP, Telangana, UP, Bihar, Maharashtra, Karnataka) have a Legislative Council – 'bicameral legislature at all State level' is false; **dual government** is the federal item, Governor and integrated services are unitary.

yae8bb73344a.add: - **Features and their Parts:** Bicameralism (Parliament) – **Part V**; Emergency – **Part XVIII**; Welfare State (DPSP) – **Part IV**; Single citizenship – **Art. 9** (no dual citizenship).
